Cool Awesome Little dynamite
Nov 2019 • Business
If you are in to bespoke cocktails, there are many bars in the city. This one’s pretty good with good English speaking staff and friendly Bartenders who really display professionalism, knowledge and the personality for the job. Not easy to find especially in Ho Chi Minh City. 

Bespoke drinks costs more than the usual smogasbord of cocktail offerings. It’s worth the price considering the creativity of the Bartenders here. They could easily whip up almost anything beyond imagination. I like that they strike up a conversation to get a feel of your personality. My regular Bartender since last year got my drink spot on. I have always been a Midori fan no matter what. I don’t know how he sniffed it but he did. Make no mistake, the other Bartenders are equally adept too. 

The good thing about this bar is its cosy, comfortable seating arrangement. You almost believe you are in a airport lounge somewhere awaiting boarding. It’s the perfect place to hangout, reflect, ponder on life and what it has to offer. If you fancy transporting yourself into another realm, you will find this place invigorating. 

Add to that a compact tapas menu with some interesting orient selections. I am inclined to think the owner is Vietnamese who lived overseas. That tapas menu looked like it’s airflown from Melbourne. 

If you are in town for a short jaunt, flying off the next day and seeking a memorable experience in a cool part of the city, look no further. Remember 52/3 Dong Du, entrance can be tricky, track the address down walk down the alley look out for a dark exterior door with even darker interior, push the door in for an experience like no other, You won’t be disappointed.
